altJa: 橙黄色の楕円形のビワ一個のイラスト。広い側の先端に褐色の萼の跡があり、反対側に短い柄が付いています。
observationJa: 楕円形からやや洋ナシ形の輪郭、橙黄色の表面、褐色の萼の跡と柄の位置を見比べます。色だけでなく果実全体の形も観察します。
limitJa: ビワの外観を学ぶための一例です。形や色、表面の毛や萼の跡の見え方は品種や状態によって異なります。この図や一つの特徴だけで全てのビワを識別したり、品種・品質・熟度・病害・食用の可否を判定したりはしません。

provenance.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an original gentle botanical 2D illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app: exactly one whole common loquat fruit (biwa), elongated oval to slightly pear-shaped, warm golden orange-yellow skin with delicate fine velvety texture, a small dark brown recessed dried calyx at the broad blossom end clearly visible, and a tiny short natural stem at the narrower opposite end. Show the entire outline unobscured, resting diagonally in a clean square composition with generous margins on plain warm ivory. Soft hand-painted gouache/watercolor botanical style, restrained fine contour and gentle dimensional shading, matching educational fruit illustrations. No leaves, branches, second fruit, cut face, flesh, seeds, ruler, labels, writing, letters, logos or watermark. Not a citrus fruit: no segmented peel, no large citrus pores. One common-appearance example only, not a specific cultivar, ripeness, quality, disease or edibility guide. Original independently composed artwork, no reference image supplied.
